53
54 virtual void add_socket(Socket *s, bool add_to_vector = true) { select.addSocket(s); }
55 virtual void remove_socket(Socket *s) { select.removeSocket(s); }
56 inline void clear_ready(Socket *s) { select.clearReady(s); }
57 virtual bool read_ready(Socket *s) { return select.readReady(s); }
58
59 void skip_next_select_timeout();
60
61 // This function needs to be used on code parts in before/after select functions, where we
62 // suspect that its operation might take a long time (> select_timeout) and will not finish the
63 // thread operation before the select timeout should have been expired if the thread had ideal
64 // operation time of zero.
65 std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point awake_timeout()
66 {
67 // Set the awake timeout to 50% of the select timeout to create a buffer of 50%
68 // to let the thread finish its work until getting to Select again.
69 return m_select_wake_up_time + std::chrono::milliseconds(int(0.50 * m_select_timeout_msec));
70 }
71
72 ieee1905_1::CmduMessageTx cmdu_tx;

96 std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point m_select_wake_up_time =
97 std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point::max();
